name: PrestaShop Icons
about: PrestaShop Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 479 icons designed by PrestaShop. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY-NC 4.0.

faqs.q: Are PrestaShop Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 479 PrestaShop Icons are open source under the CC BY-NC 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY-NC 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use PrestaShop Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many PrestaShop Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 479 icons in the PrestaShop Icons set, designed by PrestaShop. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of PrestaShop Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are PrestaShop Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
